text: The old guard watched the gate all night.
translation: 那位老守卫整夜看着大门。

text: A young guard stood at the front door.
translation: 一名年轻守卫站在前门。

text: The guards wore warm coats that night.
translation: 守卫们那晚穿着暖外套。

text: She became the guard of her little brother.
translation: 她成了弟弟的守护人。

text: Every guard carried a small black stick.
translation: 每个守卫都带一根黑色小棍。

text: Two guards stood outside the locked door.
translation: 两名守卫站在锁着的门外。
note: 门外站岗的人 = 警戒。

text: The guard shouted at the boys to stop.
translation: 守卫朝那些男孩喊停下。

text: A big dog guards the front of the shop.
translation: 一条大狗警守着店门口。

text: We must guard against any sign of fire.
translation: 我们必须警惕任何火警迹象。

text: Her face was guarded by a small hat.
translation: 一顶小帽子遮住了她的脸。

text: A small guard of soldiers walked past the house.
translation: 一小队士兵从房子旁走过。

text: The whole guard stood at attention that morning.
translation: 整支护卫队那天早上立正站着。

text: His guard arrived three hours after him.
translation: 他的护卫队比他晚到三小时。
note: 随行的一队人 = 护卫队。

text: The young guard rode beside the king all day.
translation: 那位年轻护卫整天骑在国王旁边。

text: A guard of four men watched the door.
translation: 四人的护卫队看着那扇门。
note: a guard of N = 护卫队。

text: A tall guard stood on the wall of the prison.
translation: 监狱墙上立着一个高高的防护装置。
note: 墙上的设施 = 防护装置。

text: The machine has a guard that stops the belt.
translation: 机器有一个能停传送带的防护装置。
note: 机器上的安全件 = 防护装置。

text: Keep your finger behind the guard on the press.
translation: 手指要放在压机的防护挡板后面。
note: 防护挡板 = 防护装置。

text: He fell because the guard on the machine was off.
translation: 他摔了，因为机器上的防护装置没开。
note: 防护装置失效 = 防护装置。

text: That yellow guard keeps your hand safe here.
translation: 那个黄色防护挡板在这里保护你的手。
note: 防护挡板 = 防护装置。
